days.label: Sunday
days.summary: Partly cloudy. Slight chance of a shower in the north, near zero chance elsewhere. Winds easterly 15 to 25 km/h becoming light in the late evening. Daytime maximum temperatures 25 to 30.

days.label: Monday
days.summary: Cloudy. Medium chance of showers in the north, slight chance elsewhere. Winds east to southeasterly and light becoming southeasterly 15 to 20 km/h in the early morning then tending easterly 20 to 30 km/h in the morning. Overnight temperatures falling to between 17 and 21 with daytime temperatures reaching the mid to high 20s.
